name: Room Service Door-Hanger Continental Breakfast (Bagels, Toast, Banana, Cereal)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · 24-Hour Stateroom Dining
whyItWorks: Hang the breakfast card on your stateroom door before 3 AM for complimentary early-morning delivery of plain bagels, white toast, Rice Krispies/Corn Flakes, and whole bananas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Check off Plain Bagel, White Toast, Honey/Jelly, Rice Krispies or Corn Flakes (with soy/almond milk), and Whole Banana. Do not check Grapefruit Juice or Orange Juice.
watchOuts: Never check Grapefruit Juice or Orange Juice on the door card
